message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files via pd.read_csv and displays the head, but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the ingested data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local files or user-uploaded CSVs; there is no remote fetch from URLs or cloud storage, and no checksum or integrity verification of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions for anomalies, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the uploaded or loaded data before use.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model files, and there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision anywhere in the visible pipeline code.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before training; the pipeline simply reads data and passes it to classification models.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the training flow.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in this codebase.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation; the evaluation relies on PyCaret defaults with no explicit safeguards.

No detected input sanitization: User-uploaded CSV files and manually entered file paths are passed directly to pd.read_csv without any shape, range, schema, or content validation before use in the ML pipeline.
No detected output bounds checks: No code inspects model prediction outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or calibrated thresholds before displaying or returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML classification models (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
